description: Expected agent access settings per governance zone
scopeNote: These controls apply only to Managed Environments. A non-Managed environment exposes no governanceConfiguration extended settings; Compare-ZoneCompliance reports such environments as ScopeOutOfBand (informational, not a violation).

normalization.comparisonBehavior: Broad-sharing aliases are evaluated as the Managed Environment noLimit value. The numeric bot-maxLimitUserSharing value is normalized to a category: any positive integer is Capped; -1, 0, blank, or unset is Uncapped.

maxLimitUserSharingCategories.Capped: A positive integer cap on the number of viewers a published agent can be shared with.
maxLimitUserSharingCategories.Uncapped: No finite cap (-1, 0, blank, or unset).

Zone1.description: Enterprise Managed - Restricted access for production/customer-facing

Zone2.description: Team Collaboration - Moderate restrictions for shared workloads

Zone3.description: Personal Productivity - Permissive access for individual development

regulatory_context.Critical: FINRA 4511 - Unapproved tool distribution to customer-facing users. Immediate remediation required.
regulatory_context.High: SOX 404 - Insufficient access controls for regulated workloads. Review within 24 hours.
regulatory_context.Warning: Governance gap - Environment not assigned to zone or minor deviation. Review within 7 days.
regulatory_context.Info: Informational - Zone 3 allows permissive settings by design. No action required.

bot-limitSharingMode.nolimit: Agents can be shared with anyone in the organization
bot-limitSharingMode.excludesharingtosecuritygroups: Agent sharing with security groups is excluded; sharing is limited to individual users

bot-authoringSharingDisabled.true: Agent authoring sharing is disabled (ALM-only deployment)
bot-authoringSharingDisabled.false: Agent authoring can be shared with editors

bot-maxLimitUserSharing.capped: The number of users who can be granted viewer access to a published agent is capped to a finite limit
bot-maxLimitUserSharing.uncapped: The number of users who can be granted viewer access to a published agent is not capped (-1, 0, blank, or unset)
